Subject: AirUI AP Management
Acceptance Criteria: All tab phases meet their acceptance criteria
Notes: Root work package

Subject: Status
Acceptance Criteria: All status pages report current device data without stale clients

Subject: Dashboard live summary
Acceptance Criteria: Uplink, client count, radios, uptime, CPU, memory, storage and top clients refresh correctly
Notes: Model label currently presented as AirPro AP520

Subject: Device status inventory
Acceptance Criteria: Management, uplink, device, radio and wireless-network values match the board
Notes: Internal bridge name is hidden from normal management display

Subject: Traffic and radio statistics
Acceptance Criteria: LAN live traffic has labeled axes, history, channel utilization and per-SSID counters
Notes: Live traffic is presented as Monitoring LAN

Subject: Wireless and wired client lists
Acceptance Criteria: Associated stations show RSSI, duration, SSID and band; disconnected leases are not shown as active wired clients
Notes: Current hostapd text format and identity enrichment validated; active view identifies the serving band and polls at a device-safe interval

Subject: Client disconnect action
Acceptance Criteria: Disconnect removes the selected wireless station and the refreshed count decreases
Notes: Verified with a live dual-band client; all-BSS deny prevents roaming and UI confirms disappearance

Subject: Status polling and stale-response handling
Acceptance Criteria: Polling does not overwrite newer data and visibly reports backend failure
Notes: Client refresh is single-flight, uses a 10-second interval, and no longer makes duplicate browser-side stamond requests

Subject: Network
Acceptance Criteria: Interface and wireless configuration are validated and persist

Subject: Interface inventory and editor
Acceptance Criteria: Current interfaces and editable fields match UCI and validation rejects invalid values

Subject: Interface create, update, delete and apply
Acceptance Criteria: CRUD persists and safe apply preserves management access
Notes: Test rollback when the AP becomes unreachable

Subject: Wireless radio and SSID management
Acceptance Criteria: Radio and SSID changes persist and runtime wireless state matches configuration

Subject: Wireless advanced controls
Acceptance Criteria: Isolation, band steering, airtime fairness, association limits and rate limits round-trip correctly

Subject: Stable wireless VIF identity
Acceptance Criteria: Every wifi-iface has a unique section and air_vif_id without adding radio mode fields

Subject: SSID to network mapping
Acceptance Criteria: SSID can be assigned to the intended logical network and persists

Subject: Routing configuration backend
Acceptance Criteria: Routes can be read, validated, applied and reverted safely
Notes: Current route is a placeholder and backend methods are unsupported

Subject: Administration
Acceptance Criteria: WAN and operating mode workflows are backed by real device operations

Subject: WAN management status
Acceptance Criteria: Address, gateway, DNS, lease and connection state match the management interface

Subject: WAN DHCP and static configuration
Acceptance Criteria: DHCP renews and static settings apply with safe rollback
Notes: Complete loss-of-connectivity rollback test

Subject: WAN PPPoE backend
Acceptance Criteria: PPPoE credentials validate, connect, persist and redact secrets
Notes: UI option exists; backend support is incomplete

Subject: Standalone operating mode
Acceptance Criteria: Standalone mode displays current local configuration source accurately

Subject: On-premise controller adoption
Acceptance Criteria: Discovery, manual address, connection test and adoption complete against a WLC
Notes: Registered handler currently returns unsupported

Subject: Cloud controller adoption
Acceptance Criteria: Activation code claims the AP and reports managed state securely
Notes: Requires cloud API and credential lifecycle

Subject: Security
Acceptance Criteria: Security settings enforce policy and survive reboot

Subject: MAC filtering policy
Acceptance Criteria: Disabled, allow and deny policies round-trip and are enforced per SSID

Subject: MAC filter entry lifecycle and bulk entry
Acceptance Criteria: Single and bulk MAC additions validate, deduplicate and can be deleted

Subject: Access-control rules backend
Acceptance Criteria: Rule list and CRUD operations enforce firewall policy with validation
Notes: Current backend handler is unsupported

Subject: Security input and authorization audit
Acceptance Criteria: Malformed input, privilege boundaries and command injection cases are covered by tests

Subject: Maintenance
Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance workflows are guarded, auditable and verified on hardware

Subject: Device management settings
Acceptance Criteria: Hostname and timezone settings validate, persist and display correctly

Subject: Unified system maintenance page
Acceptance Criteria: Firmware, reboot and factory-default actions share one clearly labeled page
Notes: Recommended page name: System Maintenance

Subject: Firmware image upload
Acceptance Criteria: Selected image uploads to a controlled temporary path with size and extension checks

Subject: Firmware compatibility validation
Acceptance Criteria: Validation reports signature, device compatibility and sysupgrade dry-run result
Notes: Compatible 13.8 MB YunCore image dry-run passed

Subject: Firmware upgrade execution and recovery QA
Acceptance Criteria: Validated image flashes, device reboots, settings choice is honored and UI reconnects
Notes: Real flash intentionally not yet executed

Subject: Controlled reboot
Acceptance Criteria: Confirmation schedules reboot once and UI reports reconnection
Notes: Requires final hardware evidence

Subject: Factory-default reset
Acceptance Criteria: Typed confirmation resets configuration and AP returns with documented defaults
Notes: Requires destructive hardware test and recovery checklist

Subject: Configuration backup before destructive actions
Acceptance Criteria: Backup downloads successfully and can restore the pre-change configuration

Subject: System log viewer and export
Acceptance Criteria: Logs refresh, filter and export without exposing secrets

Subject: Cross-cutting Delivery
Acceptance Criteria: Package is secure, testable, responsive and portable

Subject: Shared white and light-pink visual theme
Acceptance Criteria: Page background is white, cards use consistent light pink and decorative header shape is absent

Subject: RPC ACL coverage
Acceptance Criteria: Every declared frontend RPC has least-privilege read or write permission
Notes: Add automated declaration-to-ACL check

Subject: Consistent UBUS response schema
Acceptance Criteria: Success, validation, unsupported and runtime errors use a stable documented schema

Subject: Automated backend contract tests
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover schemas, invalid input, UCI persistence and failure paths

Subject: Responsive and browser visual QA
Acceptance Criteria: No overflow, overlap or unreadable tables at desktop and mobile widths
Notes: Attach screenshots to release work package

Subject: MT7621 platform abstraction
Acceptance Criteria: Board-specific paths and commands are isolated behind capability checks

Subject: Package build and deployment pipeline
Acceptance Criteria: Clean build installs LuCI assets, ACLs and airuid service and supports rollback

Subject: Operator and backend API documentation
Acceptance Criteria: Routes, schemas, supported platforms, recovery steps and known limitations are documented
